column1: # P.Oxy. 1231 fr. 1 col. i, lines 13-34 (= Sappho fr. 16 Voigt), Greek as printed by B. P. Grenfell and A. S. Hunt,
# The Oxyrhynchus Papyri, Part X (London: Egypt Exploration Fund, 1914), no. 1231, pp. 23 (lines 13-30) and 25 (lines 31-34).
# Scan: https://archive.org/details/oxyrhynchuspapyr10gren  (page 23 = scan leaf 47, page 25 = scan leaf 49;
# and the same with _0049.jp2; the 1914 English translation is on page 40 = leaf 64).
# Typed by hand from the page images (first pass), then re-checked character by character against 2x-6x zoomed crops (second pass, 2026-10-08).
# Transcription conventions (ours): Unicode NFC; elision mark U+2019; raised stop U+00B7; G&H's angle brackets U+27E8 U+27E9;
# the dots G&H print for lost or unread letters are kept as printed, separated by single spaces.
# Public domain (Grenfell d. 1926, Hunt d. 1934). Our transcription: CC0.
# columns: line (G&H line number in col. i) <TAB> page <TAB> text

column3: [Ο]ἰ μὲν ἰππήων στρότον οἰ δὲ πέσδων
οἰ δὲ νάων φαῖσ’ ἐπ[ὶ] γᾶν μέλαι[ν]αν
ἢ τὰ Λύδων ἄρματα κἀν ὄπλοισι⟨ν⟩
